name: Sakura AI Engine
description: Sakura Internet's domestic inference API with a free monthly request quota.
overview: Sakura AI Engine is Sakura Internet's LLM inference platform, running entirely in Japanese data centres with no training on customer data. The free plan covers 3,000 Chat Completions requests a month — and, unlike most free tiers, exceeding it throttles rather than charging — and the endpoint speaks both OpenAI and Anthropic formats, so existing SDKs work by changing the base URL. gpt-oss-120b, Kimi K2.5 and Qwen models are on the catalogue.

privacy.label: Data stays in Japan, not trained on

free_access: No automatic charges on the free plan
Data processed in Japan, never trained on
notes: The quota is per request, not per token; audio and embeddings have their own free counts.
